messages.author: 85d768b545989d80
messages.subject: Load and save default-inputs?
parts:
I'm designing a Shiny-GUI with many inputs (of all sorts (sliders, text-fields, etc.).

I want a user to start a session by selecting a file with input-defaults and then modify some of them, and then save the new choice of inputs with a new filename. The saved file should be emailable and loadable by someone else. I will design another R-script that have 1-4 saved files as inputs for calculations.

The ui.R and server.R below show the concept of the input (I'm not designing a shopping-app...). A vegetable-lover could select many vegetables and no steaks, and save file as "Vegetarian_selection".

I have read everything I can find in Stack Oveflow and on this list that relates, but I'm stuck at the very basic part of how this should be done conceptually. "reactiveValuesToList" sounds useful. I know R pretty well but have no experience in java or html. Perhaps the file should be saved in json-format?

Can someone indicate in which direction should I go forward? What concept should I study to understand how to do this?

ui.R
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Shopping List"),
  sidebarPanel(
    fileInput('file1', 'Load defaults', accept=c('text/csv', 'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain', '.csv')),
    "-----",
    sliderInput("apples", "Apples:", min=0, max=10, value=2),
    sliderInput("bananas", "Bananas:", min=0, max=10, value=5),
    sliderInput("citruses", "Citruses:", min=0, max=10, value=2),
    "-----",
    sliderInput("ribeyes", "Ribeyes:", min=0, max=4, value=2),
    sliderInput("tbones", "T-bones:", min=0, max=4, value=0),
    sliderInput("sirloins", "Sirloins:", min=0, max=4, value=2),
    "-----",
    fileInput('file1', 'Save defaults', accept=c('text/csv', 'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain', '.csv')) # This should be output.
  ),
  mainPanel()
))

server.R
library(shiny)
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  })

/Chris

parts: Look for updateSelectInput type functions. The only way I can think of is to have a observe function and it reacts to the file u have saved. When it loads the content of the file it uses a lot of updatexxx type functions to update the inputs to ur defaults.

messages.author: 10c8cda73c65d9b2
messages.subject: Re: Load and save default-inputs?
parts:
On this topic, is it possible to update a fileInput object so that it knows where to look for the previously loaded input file?  I am not sure if it is possible because input$....$datapath seems to point to a temporary directory.  The issue would then be that the user is forced to re-choose the file every time and have priotr knowledge from where the file came from.  Moreover, any other loaded settings would then be overwritten by any observe function calls that are triggered by the upload of the file.

If all else fails, the best solution I can think of is for the GUI to pause and ask the user to upload the file before proceeding with the other update calls.
